draft_text: Wrenfold was evaluated only on unseen test sets from its training domains, so whether its advantage transfers to new domains was not tested.
revised_text: Wrenfold was evaluated only on unseen test sets from its training domains, so whether its advantage transfers to new domains was not tested.
rationale: T1.r1 and T1.r2 are the only evaluations, both on Banking and Travel (the training domains). No cross-domain evaluation exists, so the claim that transfer to new domains was not tested is accurate and appropriately scoped.
